menu.intro:
CLICKER GAME
Welcome to a simple clicking game!
Leave empty to click.
Enter [H] for help on available commands. This is highly recommended if this is your first time playing.
menu.input_instructions:
Leave empty to click.
Enter [H] for help on available commands.
>>>
menu.help:
Keybinds:
- [H]: view this help menu
- [S]: save game
- [L]: load game from save file
- [U]: view upgrade menu
status.save.data_saved_new_file: New save file created. Data saved to {file}.
status.load.save_data_not_found:
Save data file {file} does not exist or is not in parent folder.
Enter [S] to save while in-game.
menu.upgrade.title: UPGRADE MENU
menu.upgrade.input_instructions:
Enter the number of an upgrade to buy it. Cost increases per upgrade level. Leave empty to leave this menu.
>>>
menu.upgrade.upgrades_info.0: "Increases the number of clicks you get per click, one at a time."
menu.upgrade.upgrades_info.1: "Increases the chance of getting a critical hit, one percent at a time."
menu.upgrade.max_level.combined: This upgrade maxes out at level {max}. It is currently at level {count}.
menu.upgrade.max_level_none.combined: This upgrade does not have a max level. It is currently at level {count}.
menu.upgrade.click_to_buy: Enter [{id}] to buy level {level} of this upgrade for {cost} clicks.
